'''Meck Feem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] scavenger who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Meck Feem lived on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he worked at the [[Senate Commercial District]] below the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A scavenger, Feem made a living passing on his knowledge of his trade to those who wished to learn.<ref name="TOR" />
